response_text: For cooperative multitasking, the user gets to decide when the os should switch contexts with osYield()- the OS does not have to do anything here but context switch. For pre-emptive multitasking, the user has to define deadlines for their threads and the os has to keep track of how much runtime each thread has left; the operating system actively triggers interrupts to force context switches.\n
